about_h2: 20 Years of Bali Roads, One Friendly Face
about_p1: I'm Ketut, born and raised in Bali. For more than 20 years I've been driving travelers from all over the world around my island — from honeymooners to families with kids and groups of friends.
about_p2: Over two decades on these roads means I know more than the way: the sunrise hour when Lempuyang has no queue, the warung with the best babi guling, the back roads that skip the traffic, and how to pace a day so it never feels rushed.
about_p3: I drive carefully, I'm always on time, and I'm happy to share stories about Balinese culture, temples and daily life along the way. With me you don't just get a transfer — you get a local friend behind the wheel.
svc1_p: Meet & greet at Ngurah Rai Airport (DPS) with a name sign. Direct, comfortable ride to your hotel or villa anywhere in Bali — day or night, flight tracked.
svc2_p: Car + driver at your service up to 10 hours. Petrol and parking included. You decide the itinerary — temples, waterfalls, rice terraces, beaches — or let me suggest one.
svc3_p: From a single excursion to a full around-the-island itinerary over several days: I plan the route, the hotels' logistics and the hidden gems with you.
tour1_p: Tegalalang rice terraces, Sacred Monkey Forest, Ubud Palace & market, Tirta Empul water temple, coffee plantation.
tour2_p: Uluwatu Temple on the cliff, Kecak fire dance at sunset, Padang Padang & Melasti beaches, seafood dinner in Jimbaran.
tour3_p: Lempuyang Temple (“Gates of Heaven”), Tirta Gangga water palace, Taman Ujung, black-sand beaches of Candidasa.
tour4_p: Sekumpul or Gitgit waterfalls, Ulun Danu Beratan lake temple, Handara Gate, Jatiluwih UNESCO rice terraces.
tours_note: All tours are 100% private and customizable — mix and match any stops. Just tell me what you'd love to see.
multi1_p: Sunrise at the Gates of Heaven before the crowds, Tirta Gangga, then a peaceful night among the Sidemen rice valleys. Bali as it used to be.
multi2_p: South cliffs and Uluwatu sunset, the heart of Ubud and its terraces, then the northern lakes, waterfalls and Jatiluwih. The complete highlights, without rushing.
multi3_p: West Bali's national park, Munduk's misty mountains, Amed's snorkeling, a Nusa Penida boat day… Tell me your dates and I'll design the full route with you.
rates_note: Prices include car, driver, petrol and parking. The exact quote depends on distance and itinerary — ask me on WhatsApp, no obligation. Entrance tickets and meals not included.
why_h2: Why book direct instead of an agency?
why1_p: Agencies and apps take 20–40% commission on top of the driver's rate. Booking direct means you pay less — and I earn fairly.
why2_p: No call centers. You message me, I answer. We plan your itinerary together before you even land in Bali.
why3_p: Flight delayed? Want to stay longer at a waterfall? No rigid schedules or change fees — we simply adapt.

faq.q: How do I book a private driver in Bali with you?
faq.a: Simply message me on WhatsApp at +62 818-0556-8096 with your dates, pickup location and what you'd like to do. I'll confirm availability and price right away. No deposit is required.

faq.q: How much does a private driver cost in Bali?
faq.a: A full-day private charter (up to 10 hours, car + driver + petrol + parking) starts from around IDR 700K depending on the itinerary. Airport transfers start from IDR 250K, and multi-day trips from IDR 650K per day. You always get the exact price on WhatsApp before booking.
Yes — I speak English and Bahasa Indonesia, and after 20 years of driving international travelers I'm used to guiding guests from all over the world.

faq.q: Can you pick us up at Denpasar Airport (DPS)?
faq.a: Of course. I track your flight, meet you at arrivals with a name sign and help with your luggage — even for late-night landings.

faq.q: Is the car air-conditioned? How many people fit?
faq.a: Yes, the car is modern and air-conditioned, comfortable for up to 5–6 passengers with luggage. For larger groups, tell me on WhatsApp and I'll arrange the right vehicle.

faq.q: Can we do a multi-day trip around Bali?
faq.a: Absolutely — multi-day trips are my favorite. I help you plan the route (East Bali sunrise, the northern lakes, Munduk, Amed and more), drive you hotel-to-hotel and adjust the plan day by day. The day rate is discounted from 3 days.

final_lead: Send me a message now — I usually reply within minutes.
